label: abortive infection system
definition: A phage defense system in which an organism possesses an abortive-infection locus that activates host growth arrest or cell death during phage infection to prevent completion of phage replication and protect nearby bacterial cells.
observations: Abortive-infection branch under phage defense system; distinct from individual ToxIN, AbiQ, AbiE, and other Abi-family subfamilies; individual toxin, antitoxin, sensor, and effector genes or proteins; toxin-antitoxin modules without direct Abi evidence; generic cell death or growth arrest outside phage defense; source database rows naming one Abi locus; and other antiphage systems such as BREX, DISARM, CBASS, CRISPR-Cas, and phosphorothioate defense.
